initialExam.title: RPF Sub-Inspector 2026
initialExam.description: Railway Protection Force Sub-Inspector recruitment for supervisory security duties in Indian Railways.
initialExam.eligibility: Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University
initialExam.syllabus: General Awareness (50Q), Arithmetic (35Q), General Intelligence & Reasoning (35Q).
initialExam.examPattern: CBT: 120 questions, 120 marks, 90 minutes. PET/PMT mandatory.
initialExam.careerGrowth: SI → Inspector → DSP level through promotions.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit RPF website 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Uniform Allowance, Free Rail passes, Medical, Pension
